CRUDE_SURGE.label: Rising crude · potential sector effects
CRUDE_SURGE.rationale: Crude >$100 boosts upstream realizations but inflates airline ATF and paint solvent raw material costs.

CRUDE_DROP.label: Falling crude · potential sector effects
CRUDE_DROP.rationale: Softening crude reduces airline fuel bills and OMC procurement costs while softening paint raw materials.

RATE_HIKE.label: Hawkish Central Bank / Rate Hike
RATE_HIKE.rationale: Rate hikes lift net interest margins for large CASA lenders but dampen rate-sensitive housing and auto demand.

RATE_CUT.label: Dovish Central Bank / Rate Cut
RATE_CUT.rationale: Lower cost of borrowing stimulates home loans, retail credit, and consumer durables.

INR_WEAK.label: Rupee Depreciation (USD/INR Rise)
INR_WEAK.rationale: Exporters billed in USD gain translation windfalls, while electronics importers face input cost spikes.

INR_STRONG.label: Rupee Appreciation
INR_STRONG.rationale: Stronger INR lowers landed cost of imported components and electronics assemblies.

GOLD_RALLY.label: Gold / Bullion Surge
GOLD_RALLY.rationale: Elevated bullion expands inventory valuation spreads and increases collateral value for gold loan lenders.

METALS_SPIKE.label: Metals / Commodity Spike
METALS_SPIKE.rationale: Primary producers benefit from expanded realization spreads, while auto and infra face higher bill-of-materials.

DEFENCE_ORDERS.label: Defence Capex & Orders
DEFENCE_ORDERS.rationale: Long-term indigenization contracts expand order backlogs and revenue visibility for domestic defence PSUs.

AI_TECH_BOOM.label: AI Capex & Semiconductor Demand
AI_TECH_BOOM.rationale: Surging enterprise enterprise AI capex accelerates application engineering and data modernization deals.
